name: hex
description: Claude Code as your personal assistant, in the client you pick: Telegram, Discord, Buzz, or one your agent builds.

paragraphs: built in 6 hours at the Personal Agents Hackathon because I wasn't happy with all the other options, this is my version of the personal assistant - as simple, elegant, portable, and modifiable as humanly possible - more capable than any other assistant on the market (Dots, Instinct, Grok Bot, Hermes, OpenClaw) - clean and solid foundation to build on, claude code updates immediately benefit hex with no modification - relies on an auto-maintained fork of Anthropic's telegram + discord connectors which support multiple threads per channel collectively, we still have a lot of work to do before…
Claude Code as your personal assistant. It runs on your own machine, and you talk to it in Telegram, Discord, Buzz and T3 Code. hex-sand.vercel.app

hex runs wherever Claude Code does, on a machine that stays on (a home server, a Mac that doesn't sleep, a cloud VM), with your own Claude subscription, and Opus 5.5 does the thinking. It's a handful of plain files around Claude Code: no framework, no database, no service manager required. One small hub process holds the bot connections and starts a Claude Code session for each conversation.

requirements.text: Every connector on your Claude account works in every hex session, with nothing to set up on the machine: Gmail, your calendar, Executor for many accounts behind one sign-in, AgentMail for an inbox of its own.
You need a machine that stays on and runs Claude Code, and a Claude subscription.
